title: Mistral Large 4 is on Hugging Face. A laptop will not run it
friendlyTitle: Mistral Large 4 is on Hugging Face. A laptop will not run it
summary: On 29 October, Hugging Face published Mistral Large 4, also called Le Chonk. It takes text and images and returns text. Hugging Face describes it as about 1 trillion total parameters and 49 billion active, with a 1 million token context. The official FP8 checkpoint is named Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B. There is also an NVFP4 build, and community GGUF files. The license is the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, which Hugging Face describes as an MIT derivative with limits on offering the model as a service.
friendlySummary: On 29 October, Hugging Face published Mistral Large 4, also called Le Chonk. It takes text and pictures and returns text. Hugging Face describes it as about 1 trillion total parameters, with 49 billion in use at a time, and a context of 1 million tokens. The official FP8 file is named Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B. There is also a smaller-number NVFP4 build, and community files in GGUF format. The license is the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License. Hugging Face describes it as close to MIT, with limits on selling the model as a service.
whyItMatters: If you want weights you can inspect, this is a current open release, not a chat subscription. Most people will not run a trillion-parameter model at home. The practical checks are the license, if you plan to serve it, and the hardware, if you plan to load it. A benchmark rank is not a reason to move a workflow onto a model you cannot host.
